    {*r} {*e} -> {*e} {*r} || EnglishStarConsonant _ {*s} {*t},
    {*r} {*u} -> {*u} {*r} || EnglishStarConsonant _ {*s} {*t},
    {*r} {*i} -> {*i} {*r} || EnglishStarConsonant _ {*s} {*t},
    {*r} {*o} -> {*o} {*r} || EnglishStarConsonant _ {*s} {*t},
    {*r} {*a} -> {*a} {*r} || EnglishStarConsonant _ {*s} {*t},
    # Stressed variants (stress preserved):
    {*r} {*é} -> {*é} {*r} || EnglishStarConsonant _ {*s} {*t},
    {*r} {*ó} -> {*ó} {*r} || EnglishStarConsonant _ {*s} {*t},

];

implications.A_vs_B: Tests s/st with the original eight-vowel enumeration.
implications.A_vs_C: Isolates vowel expansion while retaining st and the left consonant.
implications.C_vs_D: Isolates removal of t with the same expanded vowel class.
implications.historical_limit: Selected-target differences do not establish which conditioning was productive within a specific dialect and period; an attested alternative is not an unattested or intrinsically erroneous form.
